multiSelectBadges.$description: MultiSelectBadges — a summary of what's been chosen somewhere else: filters picked in a SlideOverPanel, rows ticked in a long table or tree, people added in a Dialog. Shown on the page next to what it affects ('Selected departments · 3' over the results) so the choice stays visible after the picker closes, and each one can be taken back without reopening it. Added 2026-10-27 from the Storybook MultiSelectBadges (Default, With Clear) — kept the idea, not the look: no grey slab, no black chips, no 'cs - Computer Science' codes (the name people know), 'Clear all' right after the chips instead of the far corner, and no chevron that collapses the very thing the block is for — past two rows it shows 'Show all N' instead. NOT a field: picking happens elsewhere; a field that shows its own choices as chips is Select `chips`. The chips are Chip removable base (32px — a page-level target, bigger than the 24px chips inside a field), resolved from chip.tokens.json. When the last one goes, the block hides.

title.$description: 'Selected departments' — what was chosen, in the picker's own words.

countColor.$description: The count after a middle dot ('· 3') — quieter than the title.

chipGap.$description: 8px between chips, both ways (32px chips → rows at 32, 72, 112).

action.$description: 'Clear all' and 'Show all N' — underlined link-sm in text.primary, on the chips' last row so they read as part of the set.

maxRows.$description: Rows of chips shown before 'Show all N' — two rows keep the results in view.
